prompt:
Subject:
White crochet popping by the water

Main Actor:
A near full-body portrait of a young woman in a white crochet bikini looking back beside a tropical outdoor pool. The person is placed in the center, showing a blue pool on the right, a black stone wall on the left, and a white portal frame in the background.

Person/Expression:
A small oval face turned forward over the shoulder, with large dark brown eyes looking at the camera. Thin, relaxed eyebrows, a small straight nose, and a soft smile with pale coral lips open slightly showing teeth. Fair skin with light pink cheeks. Dark brown hair with thin bangs and strands around the face, tied in a messy round bun at the back of the crown.

Clothing/Pose:
An off-white crochet bikini. The triangle top has thin ties at the back of the neck, a dense floral crochet pattern, and long ties in the center of the chest. The bottom has two-tier openwork crochet straps on both sides of the waist. Standing facing the right side of the frame, twisting only the upper body towards the camera, with hands lightly overlapping in front of the waist.

Background/Light:
A long turquoise pool extending from the right foreground to the back, a rough black lava-stone-style wall on the left, and a white square portal frame with a grey sofa and white potted plants in the center-back. Large tropical leaves and palms are at the top of the background. Bright direct sunlight from the upper-left illuminates the skin and crochet, casting hard leaf shadows on the wooden deck.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. The camera is at a horizontal eye-level, slightly higher than the subject's waist, capturing a medium-full shot from the architectural frame above to the mid-thigh. The person is large in the center, with the pool in the right third and the stone wall at the left edge; legs are cut off at the bottom. Sharp focus on the face and bikini, with the sofa and leaves in the background lightly blurred.

Texture/Style:
A high-definition photorealistic photo with bright contrast between white, turquoise, and deep green. Realistically depicts natural skin texture, three-dimensional crochet stitches, the wooden deck, stone wall, and fine reflections on the water surface.

Negative:
No major changes to facial features; do not omit the two-tier waist straps.
